# v1.2.7

Some pretty big screwups in the last version, me when i have 0 tests setup (i should maybe get to that at some point). In the meantime please keep the bug reports coming! They're very heplful.

## New features

- Vambrace optimization is here!
  - all the juice & special data were from [loa up](https://loaup.com/refine-efficiency)

## Fixes & improvements

- Optimizer no longer crashes whenever you remove an upgrade
- Settings parsing no longer treats the newest format as outdated
  - I swapped the positions of juices & books in the last update, so there was supposed to be a migration script that runs once which swapped things around. Instead it ran every time the site loaded, so you might notice your stuff swapped positions. Sorry about that!
